capability.summary: Correct the synchronization probe clock-sampling race exposed by PR #39 CI and reproduced locally. Bracket the application render callback with independent device-clock readings, account for the existing 1ms visual timestamp precision budget, and require the shown phrase/step to be current within that measured interval. Preserve one-sample audio alignment, zero late starts, stop cleanup and stale-frame rejection. Runtime source is unchanged. Keep this regression repair in the same PR as explicitly requested.

controls.range: Measured before/after render interval, with 1ms rounding allowance on each edge
controls.off_semantics: Reject a frame older than the last scheduled step before the interval, a future frame beyond the interval, mismatched phrase markers, or observer work exceeding 30ms.
controls.on_semantics: Accept the latest scheduled phrase/step at an instant within the measured rendering interval. Audio onset and deadline constraints remain unchanged.
controls.test: Six repeated dense polyphony/180ms stall runs, phrase boundaries at 40/120/220 BPM, complete browser suite, and preserved failing point-sample observations.

fixtures: Dense 15-voice steps, 180ms stalls and 4x CPU throttling
